en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a popular seafront bathhouse and beach. The structure extends along the sand with many people enjoying the sea and sun, some under sun umbrellas. On the reverse, there is handwriting in purple ink, two Bulgarian stamps with the portrait of a man, and several Cyrillic inscriptions. The printed caption under the photo reads: 'Варна — Морскитѣ бани — Warna Meer Bäder,' referring to the Sea Baths in Varna.
